svg.title: Herse — wooden field harrow
svg.desc: A low eighteenth-century animal-drawn harrow seen obliquely from above. Four oak bars in each direction form a rectangular cross-lapped lattice, stiffened with a diagonal timber brace. Sixteen tapered iron teeth descend beneath the pegged frame. A forged towing eye, ring and short linked chain are attached at its leading corner. Fine grain and sparse engraved shading describe worn oak and grey iron.
